defs.d: A period of 100 consecutive years; often specifically a numbered period with conventional start and end dates, e.g., the twentieth century, which stretches from (strictly) 1901 through 2000, or (informally) 1900 through 1999. The first century AD was from 1 to 100.

A unit in ancient Roman army, originally of 100 army soldiers as part of a cohort, later of more varied sizes (but typically containing 60 to 70 or 80) soldiers or other men (guards, police, firemen), commanded by a centurion.
The rear, back-end
Butt, the buttocks, bottom
At the back part; in the rear.
Toward the back part or rear; backward.
defs.ex: to look behind

defs.d: At the back of; positioned with something else in front of.
defs.ex: The car is behind the wall.

defs.d: To the back of.
A conversation or other form of discourse between two or more individuals.
defs.ex: Bill and Melinda maintained a dialogue via email over the course of their long-distance relationship.

defs.d: (authorship) In a dramatic or literary presentation, the verbal parts of the script or text; the verbalizations of the actors or characters.
defs.ex: The movie had great special effects, but the dialogue was lackluster.

defs.d: To discuss or negotiate so that all parties can reach an understanding.
defs.ex: Pearson wanted to dialogue with his overseas counterparts about the new reporting requirements.

defs.d: To put into dialogue form.
To prepare (food) for eating by heating it, often by combining it with other ingredients.
defs.ex: I'm cooking bangers and mash.

defs.d: To prepare (unspecified) food for eating by heating it, often by combining it with other ingredients.
defs.ex: He's in the kitchen, cooking.

defs.d: To make the noise of the cuckoo.
To throw.
The rising motion of water as a wave passes; a surge; the upward angular displacement of a vessel, opposed to pitch, the correlative downward movement.
An operation in which data is transmitted.
A messenger, especially one sent to fetch the bride.
To make something (such as an object or message) go from one place to another.
defs.ex: Every day at two o'clock, he sends his secretary out to buy him a coffee.

defs.d: To excite, delight, or thrill (someone).
A set of structured activities.
defs.ex: Our program for today’s exercise class includes swimming and jogging.

defs.d: A leaflet listing information about a play, game or other activity.
defs.ex: The program consisted of ads for restaurants and the credits of everyone connected with the play.

defs.d: To enter a program or other instructions into (a computer or other electronic device) to instruct it to do a particular task.
defs.ex: He programmed the DVR to record his favorite show.

defs.d: To develop (software) by writing program code.
defs.ex: I programmed a small game as a demonstration.

defs.d: One of the two persons from whom one is immediately biologically descended; a mother or father.
A surrogate mother
To act as parent, to raise or rear.
A foreign person, particularly:
A foreign ship.
Located outside a country or place, especially one's own.
defs.ex: He liked visiting foreign cities.

defs.d: Originating from, characteristic of, belonging to, or being a citizen of a country or place other than the one under discussion.
defs.ex: There are many more foreign students in Europe since the Erasmus scheme started.

defs.d: An amount by which a quantity is increased.
For a quantity, the act or process of becoming larger
(of a quantity, etc.) To become larger or greater.
defs.ex: His rage only increased when I told him of the lost money.

defs.d: To make (a quantity, etc.) larger.
A geometrical figure consisting of two straight lines or bars intersecting each other such that at least one of them is bisected by the other.
defs.ex: Put a cross for a wrong answer and a tick for a right one.

defs.d: Any geometric figure having this or a similar shape, such as a cross of Lorraine or a Maltese cross.
To make or form a cross.
To move relatively.
Transverse; lying across the main direction.
defs.ex: At the end of each row were cross benches which linked the rows.

defs.d: Opposite, opposed to.
defs.ex: His actions were perversely cross to his own happiness.

defs.d: The impetus behind all motion and all activity.
The capacity to do work.

An aristocratic title for a woman; the wife of a lord and/or a woman who holds the position in her own right; a title for a peeress, the wife of a peer or knight, and the daughters and daughters-in-law of certain peers.
defs.ex: Sir John Smith and Lady Smith.

defs.d: A high priestess.
The mistress of a household.
A woman of breeding or higher class, a woman of authority.
defs.ex: "I would like the dining room to be fully set by tonight; would you do so?" "Yes, my lady".

defs.d: A device that generates heat, light or other radiation. Especially an electric light bulb.
A device containing oil, burnt through a wick for illumination; an oil lamp.
To hit, clout, belt, wallop.
To hunt at night using a lamp; see lamping.
To appear; to look outwardly; to be perceived as.
defs.ex: He seems to be ill.   Her eyes seem blue.   It seems like it is going to rain later.   How did she seem to you?

defs.d: To befit; to beseem.
In the United Kingdom and Ireland, a copper coin worth 1/240 of a pound sterling or Irish pound before decimalisation. Abbreviation: d.
In the United Kingdom, a copper coin worth 1/100 of a pound sterling. Abbreviation: p.
To jam a door shut by inserting pennies between the doorframe and the door.
defs.ex: Zach and Ben had only been at college for a week when their door was pennied by the girls down the hall.

defs.d: To circumvent the tripping of an electrical circuit breaker by the dangerous practice of inserting a coin in place of a fuse in a fuse socket.
A herbal preparation made from one plant, as opposed to something made from more than one plant.
(by extension) A physician.
To gather simples, i.e. medicinal herbs.
Uncomplicated; taken by itself, with nothing added.
Without ornamentation; plain.
A fabric or structure of fibrous elements attached to each other at regular intervals.
Any interconnected group or system
defs.ex: A network of roads crisscrossed the country.

defs.d: To interact socially for the purpose of getting connections or personal advancement.
defs.ex: Many people find it worthwhile to network for jobs and information.

defs.d: To connect two or more computers or other computerized devices.
defs.ex: If we network his machine to the server, he will be able to see all the files.

defs.d: (often followed by “for”) To make an apology or excuse; to acknowledge some fault or offense, with expression of regret for it, by way of amends
defs.ex: My correspondent apologized for not answering my letter.

defs.d: To express regret that a certain event has occurred.
Organized, large-scale, armed conflict between countries or between national, ethnic, or other sizeable groups, usually involving the engagement of military forces.
defs.ex: The war was largely between Sunni and Shia militants.

defs.d: A particular conflict of this kind.
To engage in conflict (may be followed by "with" to specify the foe).
To carry on, as a contest; to wage.
The quality of being (especially visually) attractive, pleasing, fine or good-looking; comeliness.
defs.ex: 1988, "… beauty and recollection, like danger, glamour, greed, hunger- everything but disappointment and desire- were concepts belonging to other people.” -Second Son, Robert Ferro

defs.d: Someone who is beautiful.
defs.ex: Brigitte Bardot was a renowned beauty.

defs.d: To make beautiful.
Of high quality, well done.
defs.ex: He made a beauty pass through the neutral zone.

defs.d: One of the simplest or essential parts or principles of which anything consists, or upon which the constitution or fundamental powers of anything are based.
defs.ex: Letters are the elements of written language.

defs.d: A small part of the whole.
defs.ex: an element of doubt;  an element of the picture

defs.d: To compound of elements.
To constitute and be the elements of.
To put to death; to extinguish the life of.
defs.ex: Smoking kills more people each year than alcohol and drugs combined.

defs.d: To render inoperative.
defs.ex: He killed the engine and turned off the headlights, but remained in the car, waiting.

defs.d: An instance of someone being killed.
(usually as make a killing) A large amount of money.
defs.ex: He made a killing on the stock market.

defs.d: That literally deprives of life; lethal, deadly, fatal.
Devastatingly attractive.
Feeling honoured (by something); feeling happy or satisfied about an event or fact; gratified.
defs.ex: I am proud of Sivu’s schoolwork.

defs.d: Possessed of a due sense of what one deserves or is worth.
defs.ex: I was too proud to apologise.

defs.d: An instrument of attack or defense in combat or hunting, e.g. most guns, missiles, or swords.
defs.ex: The club that is now mostly used for golf was once a common weapon.

defs.d: An instrument or other means of harming or exerting control over another.
defs.ex: Money is the main weapon of modern oligarchs.

defs.d: The action of defending, of protecting from attack, danger or injury.
Something used to oppose attacks.
To furnish with defences; to fortify.
The first letter of a word or a name.
In plural, the first letter of each word of a person's full name considered as a unit.
defs.ex: You can get your initials printed at the top.

defs.d: To sign one's initial(s), as an abbreviated signature.
defs.ex: Please initial each page and sign the contract in full at the bottom.

defs.d: Chronologically first, early; of or pertaining to the beginning, cause or origin.
defs.ex: Our initial admiration for their efficiency gave way to disgust about their methods.

defs.d: Spatially first, placed at the beginning, in the first position; especially said of the first letter of a word.
defs.ex: The initial letter of names is usually printed with a capital letter.

defs.d: Very bad or intense.
Strict or harsh.
defs.ex: a severe taskmaster
